hypothesis: A full-coordinate global differential-evolution search on the absolute minimum-triangle-area objective can escape the locally stable Comellas--Yebra 12-point construction and produce a float64 improvement that merits certified follow-up.
rationale: The prior source-faithful SLSQP experiment fixed the baseline triangle orientations and returned to the published minimum from every small perturbation. Differential evolution changes both the search family and the orientation treatment, while retaining the source-faithful baseline as an elite seed. The protected transcription is not used.
expected_information_gain: Separates local stability in one orientation chart from the possibility of a globally distinct 12-point basin, and produces a candidate only if all 220 absolute triangle areas improve together.
method: Use a NumPy-only differential-evolution population over all 24 point coordinates in [0,1]^24, with one exact source-faithful baseline seed, baseline-perturbed seeds, random seeds, DE/rand/1 mutation with binomial crossover, elite retention, and a bounded Gaussian basin-polish phase. Evaluate the complete 220-triangle absolute-area objective vectorized over each population. Run three fixed seeds and preserve the complete candidate coordinates.
metric: minimum of all 220 triangle areas in float64, best triangle, and difference from the source-faithful baseline float64 minimum
metric_relation_to_true_objective: The minimum triangle area is the true objective, but float64 movement is Level 1 only. Any apparent strict improvement requires independent high-precision or certified arithmetic against the exact Comellas--Yebra baseline; failure to improve is not a global negative result.
kill_condition: Stop after the three declared runs or immediately on a candidate whose float64 minimum exceeds the source-faithful baseline by at least 1e-8; do not claim a record before independent certified verification.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only after certified comparison

previous_best_comparison.heilbronn-slsqp-001: no float64 improvement from 12 fixed-orientation starts
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new full-coordinate global search family, not a local SLSQP repeat

interpretation: Three full-coordinate differential-evolution runs retained the source-faithful Comellas--Yebra construction as their best state and produced no float64 improvement. An independent 100-digit Decimal recomputation of the retained 17-digit candidate found all 220 triangles valid with minimum area 0.032598858691819690; this is consistent with the exact baseline and is not a strict certified improvement.
what_was_learned: The published source-faithful configuration is not escaped by this bounded global DE plus Gaussian polish search under the declared population and generation budget. The result closes this specific global-optimizer family at the tested budget, not the Heilbronn problem or all global optimization methods.
recommended_next_action: Pause this global DE family and require a genuinely different structured parameterization, a capability change, or resolution of the protected baseline transcription issue before further Heilbronn compute.
repetition_justification: This is a materially different global optimizer and objective chart from the prior fixed-orientation SLSQP local search; the three seeds are declared for variance assessment rather than parameter tuning.
